Interactive D3 histogram

pv_histogram.Rd

The distribution of one numeric column as bars over equal-width bins, with a tooltip giving each bin's exact range and count. Binning follows R's own graphics::hist() rules (Sturges by default), so the shape matches what base R would show. With density = TRUE a kernel density curve is overlaid, rescaled to count space (density × n × bin width) so the curve and the bars share one honest y axis.

Usage

pv_histogram(
  data,
  x,
  bins = NULL,
  density = FALSE,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  mode = "auto",
  duration = 500,
  source = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

x

Name of the numeric column to bin. Missing values are dropped with a warning.

bins

Number of equal-width bins, or NULL for R's Sturges default.

density

Overlay a kernel density curve?

xlab, ylab

Axis titles. NULL (the default) uses the x column name for x and "count" for y; NA or "" suppresses the title; any other string replaces it.

title, subtitle

Optional chart heading text.

mode

"auto" (default: follow the viewer's light/dark setting), "light", or "dark".

duration

Entrance transition length in ms.

source

Optional source/credit line, shown small and grey at the bottom left — e.g. "Source: Bundesamt für Statistik".

width, height, elementId

Standard htmlwidgets sizing arguments.

Value

An htmlwidget.

Examples

lucerne25 <- subset(pv_fiscal, year == 2025)
pv_histogram(lucerne25, x = "resource_per_capita", bins = 20,
             density = TRUE,
             title = "Tax resources per resident, 2025")
